title: Rap Gesture Picks
heading: Eight rappers: pick the way they move
intro: Eight versions, as asked, clean room: a separate writer for each rapper researched him on the web and watched his videos frame by frame, then wrote a NEW start still (round 7 showed the start pose sets the whole gesture: every T3 clip just repeated "hand to the temple") and the clip. The rough sleeper under the flyover does Eminem, 50 Cent, Method Man and Kendrick Lamar; the rich man on the beach does Action Bronson, RZA, Ghostface Killah and Rick Ross. "now" is the T3 clip in camping song 2 beat 4. Pick the style you want (a note helps: e.g. "Method Man for Bob, Rick Ross for Tarquin") and it gets written for all 13 rap shots.

sections.lede: Duct-tape mask, under the flyover, "Waitrose door".

groups.title: s02: the rough sleeper (grey duct-tape mask), at night under a wet concrete motorway flyover in London
groups.line: "Let me explain how I'm just poor, you keep on walking through that Waitrose door!"

opts.label: Eminem: leans into a close wide lens; one hand at a time, snaps and stops dead (finger jab, arms flung wide, slap to the chest)
50 Cent: relaxed, leans in, chin dipped; one hand reaches low at the lens or flicks from the wrist; sways, feet never move
Method Man: fisheye from below; leans down over the lens; splayed hand thrust at it, fist punches, knee bounce, head ducks
Kendrick Lamar: three-quarters on, low close lens; whole arm thrust at the lens, fingers spread, then pulled back; head cocked, sharp tilts on the stresses

groups.title: s02: the new start stills
groups.line: Each version starts from its own still, posed the way that rapper moves.

sections.lede: Tweed mask, the beach, "tax the rich".

groups.title: t06: the rich man (tweed mask and tweed suit), on a bright day on a private tropical beach with palms
groups.line: "What about if we tax the rich? What the fuck you think this is, bitch?"

opts.label: Action Bronson: heavy, amused, weight back; one hand busy (the champagne), the free hand loose: finger to the sky, wrist rolls, shrug
RZA: pendulum sway, wide knees; lunges his face at a low tilted lens; loose arm swings, nothing held
Ghostface Killah: hunched into a low wide lens, off-centre; hands low, palm sweeps across the body, thumb jabs, flat chops
Rick Ross: the boss: chin up, slow heavy nods and sway; palms spread and held, hands rubbed together, fist to the lens
